# PolyPid has received Certificate of GMP Compliance of a manufacturer


July 2018


During July 2018, PolyPid has received Certificate of Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) Compliance of a manufacturer. Manufacturer’s / Importer’s Authorization (MIA) was issued following an inspections in accordance with the requirements of GMP, of the Israeli laws and regulations, and issued
